description_en: Queries the bandwidth data at a specified time for an accelerated domain
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainBpsDataByTimeStamp查询加速域名的在某个时刻不同运营商和区域的带宽数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-bps-data-by-time-stamp --domain-name example.com --time-point 2019-11-30T05:40:00Z --isp-names unicom,telecom --location-names liaoning,guangxi --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainBpsDataByTimeStamp

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name in each request
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的域名，仅支持查询单个
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The point in time to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The data is collected every 5 minutes
parameters.help_zh:
查询目标时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

查询数据粒度为5分钟
parameters.name: time_point

parameters.help_en:
The names of the Internet service providers (ISPs). Separate multiple ISPs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query regions
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。

通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口查询
parameters.name: isp_names

parameters.help_en:
The regions. Separate multiple regions with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名，多个用半角逗号（,）隔开。

通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口查询
parameters.name: location_names
